descriptions.w3d_d27a_fade_out_update_80043f00: Starting from the colour at +48, if the time since +88 is past 0x804aa97c, it clears +64, stores the time in +88 and sets the position to 0x80427468. Otherwise it lerps the position from 0x80427468 to 0x8042745c by a sine of the elapsed fraction, and lerps +32 to +48 by the clamped fraction, clamping each channel to 0..1. Then it finds the object by handle +68, sets the position through a virtual call, converts the colour to bytes and passes it to 0x8011adf8.
